groups.label: Front Matter and Preface
groups.summary: Covers publication details, dedications, acknowledgments, and editorial arrangements regarding revisions and future volumes of Plato's works.
groups.rationale: All six items form the opening paratextual and editorial apparatus of the volume, sharing an identical low reasoning depth and generality.

groups.label: Dialectic, Logic, and Art
groups.summary: Explores the philosophical significance of the Republic, warning against premature dialectical education while examining Plato's critique and contextualization of the arts.
groups.rationale: These entries address the educational, logical, and aesthetic principles of Plato's thought at an elevated level of critical commentary.

groups.label: Numbers and Mythological Vision
groups.summary: Examines Platonic mathematical symbolism, including cyclical generation numbers, intervals of pleasure, and the cosmological structure of the Myth of Er.
groups.rationale: Groups the technical analyses of Plato's mathematical formulas, numerological symbolism, and mythic cosmology.

groups.label: The Ideal State and Paradoxes
groups.summary: Analyzes the foundational models and controversial paradoxes of the Republic, including Spartan and Pythagorean influences, common property, communal family structures, and individuality.
groups.rationale: Forms a tight, contiguous sequence of political theory discussions examining the institutions, historical precursors, and radical paradoxes of Plato's commonwealth.
